hooks.name: Sprint-Aware Task Planning
hooks.description: Before starting any spec task, review Sprint.md context and the architecture steering to plan the correct file targets and approach.

action.prompt:
Before starting this task:
1. Read Sprint.md to confirm the current sprint status and which files are targeted.
2. Identify which layer this task touches (endpoint, service, repository, mobile feature, shared model).
3. Plan the file creation/modification order: contracts → backend schemas → service → endpoint → mobile DTO → API client → UI.
4. Confirm no existing patterns will be violated (check steering: project-architecture, coding-standards).
5. For mobile UI work: confirm the feature module exists under features/<name>/{data,domain,presentation}.
6. For backend work: confirm the module exists under modules/<name>/ and router is registered.
Proceed only with a clear file-level plan.
